package.name: semantic_detection
package.description: Standalone ROS 2 node wrapping a pre-trained/pre-quantized YOLOv8 object detector (CPU or Qualcomm QNN/HTP backend) for use alongside OKVIS2-X. Subscribes to a camera image topic, runs detection, and publishes vision_msgs/Detection2DArray plus an optional annotated debug image. Independent of okvis core -- ROS topics are the only integration point.
